other_conditions: Must be a registered construction worker under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Must have paid subscription fees for at least three continuous years.
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
Must remain an active construction worker.
Must not be receiving a similar pension from any other government scheme.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 to eligible registered workers.
